Army Men - Air Combat - The Elite Missio.name: Army Men: Air Combat - The Elite Missions
Army Men - Air Combat - The Elite Missio.summary:
The little green army men take to the skies once again. Choose from five different choppers (each with different defense, attack, payload and control styles) and take them onto the battlefield where you'll be asked to pick up supplies, defend fellow green army men or destroy the tan army both on the ground and in the air.

Use the tow line to pick up items and use them against the tan army, or to pick up power-ups to improve your choppers defense and attack.

2 player split screen action has you fighting against each other and racing to pick up items before the other does.

Beyond Good & Evil.name: Beyond Good & Evil
Beyond Good & Evil.summary: Beyond Good & Evil is an action-adventure game with elements of puzzle-solving and stealth-based games. The player controls the protagonist, Jade, from a third-person perspective. Jade can run, move stealthily, jump over obstacles and pits, climb ladders, push or bash doors and objects, and flatten herself against walls. As Jade, the player investigates a number of installations in search of the truth about a war with an alien threat.

Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure.name: Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure
Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure.summary: Disney characters step out of the movies and onto skateboards in Disney's Extreme Skate Adventure. You can play as your favorite Disney and Pixar characters, such as Buzz Lightyear and Woody from Toy Story 2, Simba and Rafiki from The Lion King, and Young Tarzan and Terk from Tarzan. Now you can skate, pull off tricks, and solve puzzles in all the exciting places you've seen in the movies, including Pride Rock, the Jungle Treehouse, and Pizza Planet.

Hudson Selection Vol. 3 - PC Genjin - Pi.name: Hudson Selection Vol. 3: PC Genjin - Pithecanthropus Computerurus
Hudson Selection Vol. 3 - PC Genjin - Pi.summary: This game is a 3D remake of "PC Genjin", best known in America and Europe as "Bonk's Adventure" and was released exclusively in Japan.

Mario Party 6.name: Mario Party 6
Mario Party 6.summary: Mario Party 6 offers a new batch of games that require both your fingers and your voice. In this installment in the Mario Party series, you can use the included microphone controller to talk your way to victory. More than 80 minigames are included. You can play as Mario, Bowser, or other characters from the Mushroom Kingdom. New characters appear on the board depending on what time of day it is. The game supports up to four players.

Resident Evil 4.name: Resident Evil 4
Resident Evil 4.summary: Resident Evil 4 is the sixth installment in the Resident Evil series and is often noted for its departure from the fixed camera angles of earlier titles. It introduced an over-the-shoulder third-person perspective, faster-paced gunplay, and more dynamic controls. The game features larger, more open environments and a new AI system that enables enemies to coordinate attacks and attempt to corner the player. Enemies exhibit more human-like behavior, such as climbing ladders, opening doors, and using weapons.
